All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Extends Star Elevator's Laurel Elementary elevator upgrade contract by 52 days, to Dec. 22, 2026
summary: This change order gives Star Elevator Inc. 52 more days, until December 22, 2026, to finish upgrading the passenger elevator at Laurel Elementary School. The work includes installing a new submersible pump so the elevator meets code. The text adds no money, and all other contract terms stay the same.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Lorena A. Lara - Nutrition Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Lorena A. Lara, Tulare, CA, for the latter to provide interim support for the Nutrition Services Menu Planning and Customized Allergy Responsive Eating Solutions (CARES) Program to ensure continuity of operations doing temporary staffing absence, including, coordinating menu planning activities, reviewing and supporting student meal accommodations, communicating with school sites, nurses, and Nutrition Services staff, maintaining compliance with USDA and California Department of Education regulations, supporting documentation and audit readiness, coordinating with the Central Production Kitchen, troubleshooting operational issues, assisting with weekly planning, providing staff training and guidance on CARES procedures, supporting onboarding and retraining as needed, and ensuring the safe, timely, and consistent delivery of meal accommodations for students with dietary needs; and provide recommendations to strengthen program efficiency, maintain compliance, and support uninterrupted, high-quality nutrition services throughout the duration of the engagement, via Nutrition Services Department, for the period of August 3, 2026 through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $47,500.00.
headline: Pays a contractor up to $47,500 for interim menu planning and student food-allergy meal support
summary: An individual contractor will provide temporary support for the Nutrition Services Department's menu planning and its Customized Allergy Responsive Eating Solutions (CARES) program while a staff member is absent. The work includes coordinating meals for students with dietary needs, keeping menus in line with regulations, training staff and preparing records for audits. The contract runs from August 3, 2026 through June 30, 2027, and the board is approving it after the work began.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Central California Advisors - Nutrition Services Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Central California Advisors, Turlock, CA, for the latter to provide strategic consulting services to OUSD Nutrition Services to support kitchen modernization, equipment procurement, audit readiness, staff training, and improved dining environments; assist with facility and equipment assessments, procurement processes, food safety procedures, kitchen operations, and coordination between the Central Kitchen and school sites, including onsite and remote support, staff guidance, and monthly progress updates to support the District’s transition to fresh, scratch-cooked, and culturally relevant meals, via Nutrition Services Department, for the period of August 26, 2026 through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $132,000.00.
headline: Pays Central California Advisors up to $132,000 for Nutrition Services kitchen modernization and operations consulting
summary: Central California Advisors will give the district's Nutrition Services Department strategic consulting on kitchen modernization, equipment buying, audit readiness, staff training and better dining spaces. The work also covers facility assessments, food safety procedures, operational improvements and coordination between the Central Kitchen and school sites. The agreement runs from August 26, 2026 through June 30, 2027, so the period started before this approval date.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Nor-Cal Moving Services - Nutrition Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Nor-Cal Moving Services, Hayward, CA, for the latter to provide general relocation and onsite moving services for the Nutrition Services Department on an as-requested basis during the 2026-2027 school year, supporting the movement of kitchen equipment, furniture, supplies, and related materials between Nutrition Services and OUSD school sites and facilities, as described in Exhibit A of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via Nutrition Services Department, for the period of September 16, 2026 through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $20,000.00.
headline: Pays Nor-Cal Moving Services up to $20,000 to move kitchen equipment and furniture for Nutrition Services
summary: Nor-Cal Moving Services of Hayward will provide movers, trucks, installers and equipment, as requested, to relocate kitchen equipment, furniture and supplies for the Nutrition Services Department and district school sites. The district pays set labor and equipment rates for work actually done, from September 16, 2026 through June 30, 2027. The board is approving this after the service period began.

title: Change Order No. 2, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Next Generation of Builders, LLC – Markham Elementary School Boys Toilet Renovation Project – Buildings and Grounds Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 2, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and Next Generation of Builders, LLC, Santa Clara, CA, for the latter to provide additional work for PCO#10 Hallway Tile Abatement and Drinking Fountain Rework, in the amount of $16,861.84, and PCO#11 Trim/Cleaning Around Windows, Ceiling, and Paint, in the amount of $2881.77, each, as described in the Change Order, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, for the Markham Elementary School Boys Toilet Renovation Project, in the cumulative not-to-exceed amount of $19,742.77, increasing the Agreement price from $250,271.39 to $270,014.16; and extending the term of the Agreement from June 1, 2026, through August 21, 2026  to September 30, 2026, an extension of forty-two (42) calendar days. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $19,742.77 and 42 days to Next Generation of Builders' Markham Elementary boys' restroom renovation
summary: This change order pays Next Generation of Builders for extra work on the boys' restroom renovation at Markham Elementary School. The work includes removing hazardous material from hallway tile, redoing a drinking fountain, and trim, cleaning and paint work around windows and ceilings. It raises the contract from $250,271.39 to $270,014.16 and extends the end date from August 21, 2026 to September 30, 2026, which was after the extended work period began.
source_issue: The two listed change order amounts ($16,861.84 and $2,881.77) add up to $19,743.61, but the text states a cumulative amount of $19,742.77, and the stated 42-day extension does not match the 40 days from August 21 to September 30, 2026.

title: Change Order No. 3, Lease-Leaseback Contract – Cahill Contractors, LLC – Fremont High School Modernization Project– Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 3, Lease-Leaseback Contract by and between the District and Cahill Contractors, LLC, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide additional construction services for the Phase II scope, PCOs 13-17 including the following changes: RFI 59-59.2 Conflicts with Bioretention Wall Elevations at Driveway; RFI 57 Unknown Gas Pipe Near Pile #43; CCD-011A Fire Alarm Changes, Modular Pathway to FACP; Dry-Rot Repairs at Auditorium Bldg. Entrance; and Extended GCs for Auditorium & Project Delays, as identified in PCO’s No.13 thru 17, increasing the Lease-Leaseback Contract amount by $647,761.05, from $11,757,368.71 to $12,405,129.76  and extending the term of the Contract from September 26, 2024 through June 30, 2026 to  August 31, 2026, extending term by 62 calendar days, for the Fremont High School Modernization Project.  All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Approves Change Order No. 3 for Cahill Contractors' Fremont High School modernization work
summary: This change order adds construction work to Cahill Contractors' lease-leaseback contract (a deal where the builder leases the site and leases it back to the district) for Phase II of the Fremont High School modernization. The added work covers five preliminary change orders (PCOs 13–17): a conflict with a stormwater wall at the driveway, an unknown gas pipe found near a pile, fire alarm changes, dry-rot repairs at the auditorium entrance, and extra contractor overhead costs from auditorium and project delays. The action text does not state the dollar amount; it is paid from the Measure J building fund.
source_issue: The action text approves a change order for additional construction services but does not state any dollar amount for the added work.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - RDV Consulting Services - Technology Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and RDV Consulting Services, Oakland, CA, for the latter to file the District's E-Rate forms including 470, 471, 472, 486 and 500 to apply for funding and meet E-Rate deadlines to support network services across the District, including the collection of data, providing spreadsheets of collected data, updating school data in EPC and managing PIA reviews and audits, via Technology Services Department, for the period of October 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $40,000.00.

summary: RDV Consulting Services of Oakland will prepare and file the district's E-Rate forms. E-Rate is a federal program that helps schools pay for internet and network services. headline: Authorizes state funding applications for career-tech facilities at McClymonds and Coliseum College Prep
summary: Lets district staff apply for state money through the Proposition 2 Career Technical Education Facilities Program for career-training spaces and equipment. Applications go to the California Department of Education and then, if they meet program rules, to the state Office of Public School Construction. The item does not state a dollar amount.
schools: McClymonds High School; Coliseum College Prep Academy

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - WildCare - Manzanita Community Elementary School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and WildCare, San Rafael, CA, for the latter to provide its Wildcare - Wildlife Ambassador Program at an assembly presentation for students on rehabilitated injured wildlife animals and the importance of coexistence with nature at Manzanita Community School, for the period of October 15, 2026 through October 16, 2026, in an amount not to exceed $63.80.
headline: Ratifies $63.80 WildCare wildlife assembly for students at Manzanita Community Elementary
summary: WildCare, a San Rafael organization, gave an assembly for Manzanita Community Elementary students about injured wildlife that has been rehabilitated and why it matters to live alongside nature. The agreement covers October 15–16, 2026, for up to $63.80, paid from Title I funds for low-income schools. The board is approving the agreement after the assembly took place.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Thena Gee Consulting - Early Childhood Development Department

headline: Ratifies up to $22,500 for Thena Gee Consulting to train early childhood staff in mindfulness practices

It will also train a new group of staff who already completed the EMBRACE training, so the district can keep its mindfulness work going. The agreement runs from August 17, 2026 through June 30, 2027, and the board is approving it after the service period began.

headline: Ratifies up to $50,000 for Oakland Kids First work-based learning support at Castlemont High

official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Bay Area Community Resources (BACR), El Cerrito, CA, for the latter to provide targeted, trauma-informed legal advocacy and violence-prevention services for justice-involved, newcomer, unaccompanied, and undocumented students, with core tasks including attending and advocating at court hearings, coordinating with legal and immigration systems, providing referrals and documentation support, facilitating conflict resolution and safety interventions, and collaborating with the school’s COST and safety teams to align services, reduce justice system involvement, improve attendance, and increase graduation outcomes at Rudsdale Continuation High School, for the period of September 5, 2026 through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $86,457.00.
headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $86,457 for legal advocacy and violence prevention at Rudsdale
summary: Bay Area Community Resources will provide legal advocacy and violence-prevention services at Rudsdale Continuation High School for students involved with the justice system and for newcomer, unaccompanied and undocumented students. Services include court advocacy, help with legal and immigration systems, referrals, conflict resolution and safety support, working with the school's student support and safety teams to improve attendance and graduation. The agreement runs from September 5, 2026 through June 30, 2027, so the service period began before this approval.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Safe Passages - Laurel Elementary School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Safe Passages, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide social work and therapy support services for students, through three interns being assigned to work with a caseload of up to 10 students who have been referred for extra social emotional support at Laurel Elementary School, for the period of September 18, 2026 through May 28, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $15,000.00.
headline: Pays Safe Passages up to $15,000 for social work and therapy support for students at Laurel Elementary
summary: Safe Passages will provide social work and therapy support at Laurel Elementary School. Three interns will work with up to 10 students who were referred for extra social and emotional support. The agreement runs from September 18, 2026 through May 28, 2027.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Common Vision - Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Common Vision, Berkeley, CA, for the latter to provide weekly gardening classes for the students and engage students in planting school gardens, shade trees, and orchards to create an engaging outdoor learning environment for children; and provide teacher professional development, tree stewardship, and active maintenance of edible gardens during recess and summer breaks at Martin Luther Jr. Elementary School, for the period of August 17, 2026 through September 30, 2026, in an amount not to exceed $10,000.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $10,000 for Common Vision gardening classes and tree planting at MLK Jr. Elementary
summary: Common Vision will teach weekly gardening classes and plant school gardens, shade trees and orchards to create an outdoor learning space for students at Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary School. The agreement covers August 17 through September 30, 2026, for up to $10,000. This is a ratification, meaning the service period began before the Board's vote.
schools: Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary School

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - WildCare - Greenleaf Elementary School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and WildCare, San Rafael, CA, for the latter to provide an assembly presentation for the students on rehabilitated injured wildlife animals and the importance of coexistence with nature, as specified in Exhibit A of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth,  at Greenleaf Elementary School, for the period of October 21, 2026 through October 22, 2026, in an amount not to exceed $78.00.
headline: Ratifies $78 WildCare wildlife assembly for students at Greenleaf Elementary
summary: WildCare, a San Rafael nonprofit, will give students at Greenleaf Elementary an assembly about rehabilitated injured wildlife and why living alongside nature matters. The agreement covers October 21–22, 2026, and costs up to $78. The board is ratifying it, which means approving it after it was arranged.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Destiny Arts Center - Manzanita Community Elementary School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Destiny Arts Center, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide approximately 150 Manzanita students with an average of 30 hours of Martial Arts instruction and Social and Emotional skills to further their growth as individuals and a community; grow their skills in and knowledge of Martial Arts, as well as become familiar with and practice the tenets of the Warrior’s Code: Love, Care, Respect, Honor, Responsibility, Peace; and a culmination of work will be showcased sometime during the school year for the school and community to view and celebrate at Manzanita Community Elementary School, for the period of September 8, 2026 through May 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $10,000.00.
headline: Pays Destiny Arts Center up to $10,000 for martial arts and youth development classes at Manzanita Community Elementary
summary: Destiny Arts Center of Oakland will teach weekly martial arts and creative youth development classes at Manzanita Community Elementary School, totaling 210 hours. The classes aim to help students build social connection, emotional expression and self-confidence. The agreement runs from September 8, 2026 through May 30, 2027.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Children Rising - Brookfield Elementary School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Children Rising, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide its Success By Reading Program (SbR), a one-on-one, twice weekly tutoring program for second and third graders provided during school hours for students referred by the school staff who lack foundational reading skills, and are typically 1 ½ - 2+ years behind in their grade level skills at Brookfield Elementary School, for the period of October 5, 2026, through May 27, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $5,000.00.
headline: Pays Children Rising up to $5,000 for one-on-one literacy tutoring at Brookfield Elementary
summary: Children Rising, an Oakland organization, will give one-on-one reading tutoring twice a week to Brookfield Elementary students who are struggling with basic reading skills and are referred by school staff. The agreement runs from October 5, 2026 through May 27, 2027. The board is approving it after the service period began.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Julie Kurtz - Early Childhood Development Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Julie Kurtz, Danville, CA, for the latter to provide six full-day professional development sessions on trauma-responsive practices, which includes presentations at the three ECE Staff Professional Development Day five half-day sessions on trauma-responsive practices, via Early Childhood Development Department, for the period of August 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $40,000.00.
headline: Pays a trainer up to $40,000 for trauma-responsive training for early childhood education staff in 2026-27
summary: This contract pays an individual trainer from Danville, CA, to lead training sessions on trauma-responsive, stress-reducing and resilience-building strategies for professionals in the Early Childhood Development Department. It runs from August 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027 and costs up to $40,000. The board is ratifying it after the service period began.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Planting Justice - Dewey Academy
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Planting Justice, Oakland, CA, for the latter to educate students in the Health Pathway on nutrition and the study of nutrients in food, how the body uses nutrients, and the relationship between diet, health, and disease; deliver interactive lessons focused on the study of nutrients and human biology; facilitate practical exercises for real-world health scenarios and provide actionable guidance on weight management and dietary wellness so students can fully understand their own health; teach students why they truly are what they eat, and how to properly lose weight, maintain a healthy weight, or gain weight, teach which foods are healthy and which foods are damaging, with this year-long program serving 126-150 students at Dewey Academy, for the period of August 10, 2026 through May 27, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $50,000.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $50,000 for Planting Justice nutrition lessons in Dewey Academy's Health Pathway
summary: Planting Justice will teach students in Dewey Academy's Health Pathway about nutrition, how the body uses nutrients, and how diet relates to health and disease, using interactive lessons and real-world health exercises. The year-long program serves 120–150 students from August 10, 2026 through May 27, 2027. This is a ratification, meaning the board is approving an agreement whose service period may already have begun.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Cantare Con Vivo - Lincoln Elementary School

headline: Pays Cantare Con Vivo up to $43,918 for weekly music classes at Lincoln Elementary
summary: Cantare Con Vivo will teach weekly music classes for transitional kindergarten through 5th grade students at Lincoln Elementary School. The classes will end with a performance showcase for the school community and families. The agreement runs from September 18, 2026 to May 20, 2027, and the board is approving it after the service period began.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Blueprint Schools Network - Oakland High School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Blueprint Schools Network, Needham, MA, for the latter to provide support with systems development and by collaboration with each school to develop schedules, systems, and processes for a successful implementation of the program, customizing Common Core-aligned curricular materials to ensure tutorial sessions complements and support OUSD's curriculum, coordinate with school administration on order fulfillment for furnishings and other material necessary for program implementation, and collaborating with administration to identify dedicated tutorial space and communicate expectations for appropriate tutorial learning  environments for 2026-27 Program Development; work with 9th grade and targeted students that will participate in the initiative based on school priorities, build the capacity of staff members with the intent of establishing long-term school based support and infrastructures, design and implement a quality math acceleration program based on high dosage tutoring, provide a team to prepare for and support the implementation of a quality program; recruit and train staff with professional development at Oakland High School, for the period of August 10, 2026 through May 28, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $150,000.00.
headline: Pays Blueprint Schools Network up to $150,000 for daily small-group math tutoring at Oakland High School
summary: Blueprint Schools Network will run its "Blueprint Math Lab" at Oakland High School. Tutors called Fellows work with groups of no more than four students for 45–60 minutes each day to support what students learn in their regular math class. The agreement runs from August 10, 2026 through May 28, 2027 and is paid from federal Title I funds for low-income schools.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Partners in School Innovation - Reach Academy

headline: Pays Partners in School Innovation up to $40,000 for principal and staff coaching at Reach Academy

The contract costs up to $40,000, paid from federal Title I funds for schools serving low-income students. The board is ratifying this agreement after the service period began.

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Kirstin Hernandez - Early Childhood Development Department

headline: Pays a contractor up to $18,000 to set up and support ParentSquare at 32 early childhood education sites
summary: An individual contractor will set up, maintain and oversee the ParentSquare communication app for the district's 32 Early Childhood Education sites. The contractor will also work with the district's research and tech teams and give technical help and training to early childhood administrators and staff. The agreement runs from October 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, and is being ratified after that start date.

headline: Ratifies $50,000 for Blueprint Schools Network daily small-group math tutoring at Castlemont High
